utility_environmental_service.label: Utility / environmental service
utility_environmental_service.value: Natural gas distribution and transmission, propane distribution, electricity distribution, mobile gas delivery, and electricity and steam generation.

regulated_competitive_operating_model.label: Regulated / competitive operating model
regulated_competitive_operating_model.value: Rate-regulated natural gas distribution and transmission and electricity distribution, alongside unregulated propane distribution, mobile gas delivery, and electricity and steam generation.

generation_fuel_technology_mix_electric_.label: Generation fuel / technology mix [electric generators]
generation_fuel_technology_mix_electric_.value: Natural gas-fired combined heat and power at Eight Flags, with hydrogen blending capability demonstrated in a test.

connections_service_accounts.label: Connections / service accounts
connections_service_accounts.value: Natural gas and electricity distribution customers, plus residential and commercial propane accounts.

service_specific_rated_capacity.label: Service-specific rated capacity
service_specific_rated_capacity.value: Utility-scale baseload generating capacity at the Eight Flags combined heat and power plant on Amelia Island.

regulatory_jurisdiction.label: Regulatory jurisdiction
regulatory_jurisdiction.value: State public service commissions in Florida, Delaware and Maryland, and the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission for interstate natural gas transmission.

gas_network_delivery_gas_utilities.label: Gas network / delivery [gas utilities]
gas_network_delivery_gas_utilities.value: Natural gas distribution and pipeline transmission, plus Marlin Gas Services’ nationwide virtual pipeline delivery of CNG, LNG and RNG.

steam_irrigation_service.label: Steam / irrigation service
steam_irrigation_service.value: Steam generation at the Eight Flags combined heat and power plant on Amelia Island.

notes: The evidence leaves approved rate base, electricity output, generator capacity factor and electric peak demand unspecified.
